dialogues.speaker: Koch
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight! Koch the gunsmith greets you. May your range estimates be precise, and your ballistics ideal.

choices.text: About the other workings of the "observation grenade"...

response.speaker: Koch
response.text: Let me guess — you're going to ask: How does it change direction?

response.speaker: Koch
response.text: Ha! The principle isn't actually that complicated. The grenade body uses a low-energy smokeless powder, so its speed isn't anything dramatic.

response.speaker: Koch
response.text: Pair that with the adhesive devices around the observation mechanism, and on impact it sticks to the target — then the side-mounted tracer at the rear ignites, sending out a hit-confirmation signal.

response.speaker: Koch
response.text: The remaining space in the warhead is packed with directional charges. Once it's been remotely guided to point at the next target, igniting those propellants sends it flying onward.

response.speaker: Koch
response.text: And so, in a wargame, the "observation grenade" can perform a limited number of redirections.

response.speaker: Koch
response.text: Which fits the wargame's theme perfectly — "with a finite number of shots, achieve the most flawless trajectory."

choices.text: I'll come back to chat with you in a bit.

response.speaker: Koch
response.text: Understood. I'm here on standby anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Koch
dialogues.text: Almost done for the day... fancy a couple of drinks at The Rusty Rudder over there?

dialogues.speaker: Hedwig
dialogues.text: Drinks!? You'd be paying out of your own pocket, then? I'm not approving a single Mora for it.

dialogues.speaker: Koch
dialogues.text: All good — we'll cover it ourselves, and bring a few good bottles back for Horken, Ursula, and Gunther! Oh, and Captain Kaeya and the Grand Master too!

dialogues.speaker: Hedwig
dialogues.text: Count me out, regardless. I've got to organize the records from this wargame properly, and the Ranged Company has to leave someone behind to help me!

dialogues.speaker: Hedwig
dialogues.text: And there's the Special Patrol's written documentation for the Grand Master, the study-exchange plan... we've gone and made another fine start to something without even meaning to!
